summary: Correct OD-012 R3 to freeze every archive and RECORD byte choice.
why: OVR-000072 fixed the high-level archive profile but did not select the complete RECORD CSV grammar, final-name ordering, every ZipInfo field, ZIP64 rejection, or explicit post-write validation boundary. Those omissions leave implementation latitude through CPython defaults. Historical R3 authority remains immutable; a replacement must incorporate it unchanged and add the complete deterministic byte grammar.
